active_product_bottleneck.next_discriminator: Mandatory frame review: stop serial proof/cache shaving. Test bounded parallel winner staging as a materially different execution architecture. Stage immutable winner snapshots concurrently under deterministic per-candidate aggregate-memory reservations, keep Builder mutation/commit serial, retain each source's independent final live digest rebind, and fall back safely when a candidate cannot fit the parallel reservation.
